title: Evaluation of the unary proper-image coefficient mate
statement:
The following fully quantified Lean statement is the unary/finite component in the support-coordinate argument. All operations and normalizations are those of [def-sf-operation-stages], and its explicit coordinate maps are those of [def-sf-integral-projection-factor-evaluation-data] and [def-sf-integral-projection-middle-map].

theorem integralProjectionDirectFactorEvaluation
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left) (m : ℕ)
    (M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E (identitySquare f c).Z.obj.left) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation C.l E Y.obj.left m).map
        (ProjectionFactors.directReduction D C E n hn S hl o z f c M) ≫
      ((o.evaluation c.g).evaluation m).hom.app
        ((calculus C.l E c.Z).reduction.obj M.obj) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage c.g
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E (m + 1))).map
          (((calculus C.l E c.Z).reductionEvaluation m).hom.app M.obj) =
    ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reductionEvaluation m).hom.app
        (((S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)).stage.properPush.obj M).obj) ≫
      (FactorEvaluation.direct D C E n hn S f c m M).hom

def-sf-operation-stages, pullProjection and the coefficient counit equation.

proof.text: Compose the direct-adjunction coefficient comparison for integral reduction with the finite stage's normalized direct-adjunction comparison. Their counit equations compose by naturality of the inverse left comparison. Transport this counit equation from integral.pullDirectAdjunction to the exchange stage using its properPull, properPush and properAdjunction fields.

Apply integralProjectionPullEvaluation to the proper morphism and each integral constructible input. Postcompose with finitePullback to cancel its inverse, then move the exchange-stage properPull equality transport through reductionEvaluation by naturality. This identifies evaluation of properPullReduction with the composite normalized finite left comparison.

The private evaluateTranspose lemma transports any adjunction transpose through an evaluation square satisfying the counit equation; it follows by injectivity of the finite Hom equivalence, counit naturality and the triangle identity. The private mateEvaluation lemma additionally conjugates the source and target coordinates by their specified isomorphisms. Apply these to directReduction, the evaluated properPullReduction equation, and the transported finite counit equation. Naturality of reductionEvaluation identifies the remaining counit coordinates. Expanding the right comparison gives precisely FactorEvaluation.direct.
